scope: Plan4.7B supervised readout robustness, frozen encoders/dynamics. Prespecified native-future-compatible features; LeWM spatial capture excluded because native prediction does not expose corresponding spatial output. Each subset seed has nested25/50/100% training families shared across representations. Ridge alpha selection on same development families/grid; MLP seed fixed for subset effects. Full deterministic ridge/controls fit once, MLP three initialization seeds. Existing exact-matching first-seed subset and full models reused with subset/model hashes. Repeated training subsets are correlated, not independent datasets; report training variation separately from evaluation-family intervals. No finaltest, no new representation winner chosen on calibration. Capture stage alone does not complete B; same models must undergo real/predicted intervention-effect evaluation.
